title: Global Callisto in Color
qualification: USGS redistributes the published processed plate with a transparent limb cutout. NASA calls it a global image meaning a full visible disk; this does not establish whole-sphere coverage. The RGB values are not calibrated I/F. Alpha antialiasing and color fringing persist in the source.
pixelScale: The retained approximately 640-pixel diameter corresponds to about 7.5 km per pixel near the center of the projected disk, approximately 8 km class. Surface sampling worsens toward the emission boundary. The 0.25-degree derived map and 8192-pixel display atlas do not add resolution.
